source.author: stat
source.text: Iamque emensus iter silvis ac litore durum, qua Lernaea palus ambustaque sontibus alte intepet hydra vadis, et qua vix carmine raro longa sonat Nemee nondum pastoribus ausis, qua latus Eoos Ephyres quod vergit ad curos Sisyphiique sedent portus irataque terrae curva Palaemonio secluditur unda Lechaeo.
source.text_original: Iamque emensus iter silvis ac litore durum, / qua Lernaea palus ambustaque sontibus alte / intepet hydra vadis, et qua vix carmine raro / longa sonat Nemee nondum pastoribus ausis, / qua latus Eoos Ephyres quod vergit ad curos / Sisyphiique sedent portus irataque terrae / curva Palaemonio secluditur unda Lechaeo.
source.text_english: And now, having measured out the harsh journey through woods and along the shore, where the Lernaean marsh and the hydra, burned in its guilty shallows, stills them from deep below, and where Nemea, scarcely ever sounding with a few shepherds’ songs, where the side of Ephyre that slopes toward the eastern lands and the ports of Sisyphus lies, and where the curving wave is shut off from the land by angry Lechaeum, Palaemon’s harbor.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tendite in astra, viri: mea primum regia mundo Iapeti post bella trucis Phlegramque labores imposuit: durum vobis iter et grave caeli institui.
reuse.text_original: 'tendite in astra, viri: mea primum regia mundo / Iapeti post bella trucis Phlegramque labores / imposuit: durum vobis iter et grave caeli / institui.
reuse.text_english: Strive toward the stars, men: my kingdom first imposed on the world, after the wars of savage Iapetus and the labors at Phlegra, a hard and weighty journey to heaven I have established for you.
